findings.message: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 2 application services (geopulse-backend, geopulse-ui). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
Persistent local filesystem storage is not supported
This app uses PostgreSQL but has no migration command; schema updates will not run on deploy.
Deployz ignores the deployment files in this repository (helm/geopulse/Chart.yaml). It builds the Dockerfile and provisions the infrastructure itself.
